Please switch this test-mode check to something Vite-safe (e.g. `import.meta.env.MODE === 'test'`) or a shared env helper used elsewhere in the app.

body: This test’s custom `useMutation` mock will treat exceptions in `onSuccess` as a mutation failure and route them through `onError`. In this file, the component’s `onSuccess` calls `queryClient.invalidateQueries(...)`, but the shared unit-test mock for `useQueryClient()` only provides `refetchQueries`/`setQueryData`, so the success path currently throws and the mock converts it into an error path. Mock `useQueryClient` here to include `invalidateQueries` (and/or update the shared mock) so the test actually exercises the success behavior rather than silently falling back to error handling.

author: Copilot
body: These assertions use `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(initialCallCount)`, which can pass even if no re-query happens after changing the filter (i.e., call count stays the same). Since the test intent is to verify a requery, assert that the call count increases (or assert on the new call's arguments) so the test fails on regressions where the query is not re-fired.

author: Copilot
body:
This expectation uses `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(initialCallCount)`, which allows the assertion to succeed even if the filter change does not trigger any additional query call. To keep this test meaningful, assert that the call count increases (or validate the parameters of the latest call) after interacting with the 'Initiated By' filter.
```suggestion
    expect(vi.mocked(activityLogsQuery.useFetchAuditRecords).mock.calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(initialCallCount);
```
